answer: Sybil resistance binds identities to bonded collateral escrows and aggregates evidence of coordinated equivocation: for k identities, pairwise accountability yields Θ(k²) penalty exposure, not a flat per-identity fine. Upon detection, asymmetric depreciation applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, so splitting control across aliases magnifies the swarm’s risk. A zephyr of equivocation can become a gale at the zenith of exposure.
